description: This Java class, DatatableNameGenerator, is responsible for generating randomized names for datatable entities within the Apache Fineract project. It uses a helper utility to create a random string based on a formatted prefix derived from the entity type's referenced table name.

classes.name: DatatableNameGenerator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for generating random datatable names based on entity types.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a randomized name string for a given datatable entity type, formatted as 'dt_{referenced_table_name}_' followed by a 5-character random string, all in lowercase.
